title: 第375章 地府观影如懿传刀后革命1第374章 正史观影如懿传有难题看我手动解决10
content_zh:
看着又闹腾起来的大清皇室，黑无常只觉得头疼。
自从康熙皇帝死下来以后，这大清的一群鬼就没安稳过。
“仁孝皇后，您想与康熙帝和离的事情，我真做不了主啊，我就是个平平无奇的勾魂使者，管不了姻缘啊！”
听到这话，赫舍里氏忍不住眉头一蹙，说道：“叫我赫舍里氏就行，不是仁孝皇后。”
“芳儿，家丑不可外扬，承祜还是个孩子，你难道就不顾及他吗？朕......”
这厚颜无耻的话一出，赫舍里氏再也忍不住了，骂道：“家丑？有些人既然敢不干人事，就别怕被骂。死麻子，我告诉你，这婚我离定了。”
承祜紧随其后道：“额娘，儿子支持你，老麻子他对我保成弟弟不好，我们也不要他，长得像个丑八怪，尽在那恶心人，哼！”
母子二人说完之后，直接相携离去，只留下面色通红的康熙和看热闹的众人在原地。
围观的众人：这伦理大戏，他们怎么就那么爱看呢？
哈哈哈，老头子，你也有今天！
光绪、同治都羡慕哭了，这么好的额娘，他们怎么就没遇上，反而遇上了野心勃勃的老妖婆慈禧，呜呜呜。
“傅仪，你给朕滚过来，要不是你的‘刀妃革命’，芳儿怎么可能有这个想法？”
傅仪：......我冤啊！
“还有你们这群孽障，你二哥失踪这么多年，你们连人都找不到，要你们何用？”
“那个、那个汗阿玛，大清都亡了，二哥早就是是鬼了，他......”
“朕说是人就是人，保成身份尊贵，就是在地府，也不会你们这些庶出一个待遇。”
！！！
你是不是忘了你自己的身份啊？别以为你老娘是圣母皇太后，你就是嫡出，你个假冒伪劣的玩意。
“哈哈哈，自己嫌弃自己庶出的身份，康麻子，你的精神状态还好吗？不过被刀也没事，正好给你家清三退傅仪打个样，皇帝被离婚，哈哈哈。”
听到朱棣的嘲讽，康熙瞬间意识到自己失言了，于是咬牙到：“朱老四，你找死吗？”

“来啊来啊，老子一个马上皇帝，还能怕了你？”
“你......”
看着这群子孙后代的模样，努尔哈赤咬牙道：“皇太极，你能不能管管你的后代？整日看丢人闹腾，让老朱家看笑话，你到底能不能行！”
已经习惯被甩锅的皇太极见此，直接瞪了儿子一眼，骂道：“福临，没听见你玛法的话吗？聋了吗？”
顺治刚想开口，就被黑无常给打断了。
“那个、那个，大家和气生财，最近新出了不少影视剧，我请大家免费看。你们不会不给我老黑面子吧？”
朱厚照嘿嘿一笑，说道：“老黑你的面子我们老朱家肯定给，老爱家给不给那就不知道了呢。”
爱新觉罗家众人：......我们敢不给吗？
想着自己因为老爱家加的班，黑无常在选的时候暗中动了手脚。
看着水镜中《清成祖实录》几个字，观看的众人瞬间默了。
大清有清成祖这个人吗？想到这，众人不由看向成祖的开创者朱棣。
content_en:
Seeing the Qing imperial family making a fuss again, Hei Wuchang only felt a headache.
Ever since the death of Emperor Kangxi, this group of ghosts in the Qing Dynasty have never had peace.
"Queen Renxiao, I really can't decide whether you want to reconcile with Emperor Kangxi. I'm just a mediocre seducer and I can't control the marriage!"
Hearing this, Mr. Hesheli could not help but frown and said, "Just call me Mr. Hesheli, not Queen Renxiao."
"Fang'er, don't make your family's scandal public. Chenghu is still a child. Don't you care about him? I..."
As soon as these shameless words came out, Mr. Hesheli couldn't bear it anymore and cursed: "Family scandal? Since some people dare to do nothing, don't be afraid of being scolded. Damn it, I tell you, I'm divorced."
Chenghu followed closely and said: "Mother, my son supports you. Lao Mazi is not good to my younger brother Baocheng, and we don't want him. He looks like an ugly monster, but he is so disgusting, huh!"
After the mother and son finished speaking, they left together, leaving only the red-faced Kangxi and everyone watching.
Everyone watching: Why do they love watching this ethical drama so much?
Hahaha, old man, you have today too!
Guangxu and Tongzhi both cried with envy. Why didn't they meet such a good mother-in-law? Instead, they met the ambitious old witch Cixi.
"Fu Yi, come here. If it weren't for your 'Sword Concubine Revolution', how could Fang'er have this idea?"
Fu Yi: ...I am wronged!
"And you bunch of scoundrels, your second brother has been missing for so many years and you can't even find him, so what use are you?"
"That, that Khan Ama, the Qing Dynasty is dead, and the second brother has been a ghost for a long time, he..."
"I say that a human being is a human being. Baocheng has a noble status. Even in the underworld, you commoners will not be treated the same."
! ! !
Have you forgotten your own identity? Don't think that your mother is the Holy Mother and the Queen Mother, and you are just a legitimate descendant, you fake thing.
"Hahaha, I despise my status as a concubine. Kang Mazi, are you in a good mental state? But it's okay to be stabbed. It's just a good example for your family to quit Fu Yi and the emperor to be divorced, hahaha."
Hearing Zhu Di's taunt, Kangxi instantly realized that he had made a mistake, so he gritted his teeth and said, "Zhu Laosi, are you looking for death?"
"Come on, come on, I am an emperor on horseback, how can I still be afraid of you?"
"You..."
Looking at the appearance of these descendants, Nurhachi gritted his teeth and said: "Huang Taiji, can you take care of your descendants? I watch the embarrassment and commotion all day long and make the old Zhu family laugh. Can you do it?"
Seeing this, Huang Taiji, who was used to being blamed, glared at his son and cursed: "Fu Lin, didn't you hear what your Mafa said? Are you deaf?"
Just as Shunzhi was about to speak, he was interrupted by Hei Wuchang.
"Um, um, everyone can make money by being friendly. There have been a lot of new movies and TV series recently. I invite everyone to watch them for free. You won't give me the old black face, right?"
Zhu Houzhao chuckled and said: "Lao Hei, our Lao Zhu family will definitely give you your face, but I don't know if the Lao Ai family will give it to you."
Everyone in the Aixinjueluo family:...Do we dare not to give it?
Thinking about the overtime work he had to do because of his old love, Hei Wuchang secretly tampered with the choice.
Looking at the words "Records of Qing Chengzu" in the water mirror, everyone watching fell silent for an instant.
Was there a person named Chengzu of the Qing Dynasty in the Qing Dynasty? Thinking of this, everyone couldn't help but look at Zhu Di, the founder of Chengzu.
